items.description: S3 Arctic system with EO/IR gimbal

notes: Engineering Sprint ROM/SOW submitted 2026-07-31 for Joint Forces Command evaluation. Demos planned: Ottawa June 24–26, 2026 (flight test + vendor meet); Whitehorse Arctic Nov–Apr 2027. Customer seeking 120km range (1h 35min TOF) S3 with EO/IR gimbal. End of Q2 2027 target at earliest. No delivery dates promised yet; sales plan organization in progress. Recent Slack (2026-10-21) confirms no sales plan yet and no QBO invoice on file for this task.
